街.meaning: Right in the middle of the <part>crossroads</part>, someone builds a <part>double mound</part> of earth, like a two-tier cake, and plants palm trees on it. Soon cafés open on every corner and people stroll past in sunhats. The old crossing has become a grand <kanji>boulevard</kanji>.
街.on: A <sound>gui</sound>de dog leads its owner down the middle, sniffing at every café table.
街.kun: '<sound>Ma</sound>, look!' shouts a boy, pointing at a shop selling wheels of <sound>chee</sound>se as big as tyres.

推.meaning: A <part>sparrow</part> perches on an old <part>anchor</part> half buried in a field, miles from the sea. Where did it come from? A flood? A giant? A flying ship? The bird tilts its head and makes its best <kanji>conjecture</kanji>.
推.on: It decides a pirate dropped it while chasing a <sound>swee</sound>t, and pecks the rust to see if it tastes sugary.
推.kun: Then an <sound>o</sound>ctopus wriggles out of the mud and pushes the whole anchor over.

被.meaning: A farmer nails an old <part>pelt</part> to his <part>weathervane</part> to scare off crows. Instead, the wind spins it so fast that it flings mud, hail and leaves all over his roof. With every storm, the damage his house will <kanji>incur</kanji> doubles.
被.on: Climbing up to fix it, he slips on the mud and snaps the <sound>hee</sound>l off his boot.
被.kun: In the end he pulls the pelt over his head like a hat, while a <sound>ca</sound>rp in the pond and a <sound>bu</sound>ll in the field stare at him.

爆.meaning: A grumpy chef has an <part>outburst</part> and slams his pan down on the <part>fire</part>, forgetting it's full of popcorn. Kernels shoot up, the lid flies off and the window shatters. The whole kitchen goes off like a <kanji>bomb</kanji>.
爆.on: The blast is so strong it snaps the <sound>buc</sound>kle off his apron belt.
爆.kun: '<sound>Ha</sound>!' laughs the waiter, catching a flying kernel in his mouth.

賞.meaning: At the seaside fair, a humble <part>shellfish</part> is held up high on a velvet cushion, glowing in the town's <part>esteem</part>. It won the sandcastle contest by building a whole castle in one night, all by itself. Its shiny ribbon is the top <kanji>prize</kanji>.
賞.on: It bows to the crowd at the end of the <sound>show</sound>, waving one tiny claw.
賞.kun: Everyone praises it with gifts: a <sound>ho</sound>tdog and a slice of <sound>me</sound>lon.

香.meaning: A monk dries a bundle of <part>grain</part> stalks in the <part>sun</part> until they're crisp, then lights the tips. Instead of smoke, puffs of fresh-bread smell drift through the temple, and every stomach rumbles during prayers. He has made breakfast-flavoured <kanji>incense</kanji>.
香.on: He stands each stalk upright in an ice cream <sound>co</sound>ne so the ash won't fall on the floor.
香.kun: In the temple pond, a <sound>ca</sound>rp sniffs the air, gasps '<sound>Oh</sound>!' and leaps right out over the <sound>ree</sound>ds.
